objective.photo: Examine the faded photograph on the central reading desk.
objective.seal: Pass through the north arch. Follow the corridor east to the seal.

story.photo: On the back, in a scribe’s hand: “My name is in the register in the sealed vault.”
story.closed: The seal is cold. A faded photograph rests on the reading desk.
story.open: The seal releases. Beyond the stone door lies the scribe’s register.
